claim: AW05 / A-038 (analytics walk 2026-10-03): a verified receipt's own-paper price sighting was dated by the moment its paper was checked (procurement.service.ts:6909 @8c673db4b, observedAt: update.match_verified_at), on the false premise that procurement_documents has no issue-date column (it has doc_date, baseline_from_production.sql:4433), so every observed_at window counted a July invoice checked in September as September's. ADR 0273 (Proposed; branch fix/price-sighting-dated-by-issue) dates it by the issue date of the one invoice pickReceiptPaper names: doc_date with the latest kind='correction' issueDate row laid over it, observed_at = min(issue day 12:00Z, verifiedAt), effective_date = the issue day, the check time only as a fallback with raw.dateSentence saying why, price_history.effective_date the same day, and the compare DTO mapping raw.dateBasis. What this row resolves is the writer's dating, for a house that files its invoices. A-038 itself stays open: the sim house it was measured in holds no document, its rows already written are not re-dated (ADR 0273 F2), and which source wrote its 25 sightings was not measured, so its 30, 95 and 365-day counts do not move here. The verify reads procurement.service.ts, own-paper-sighting.ts and vendor-comparison.service.ts with comment lines (starting //, /* or *) dropped, and requires: the old observedAt: update.match_verified_at is gone; verifyReceipt passes observedAt: receiptDate.observedAt and dating: receiptDate; receiptPaperFor selects doc_date; the corrections read filters field_path issueDate and kind correction; price_history reads args.sighting?.dating?.effectiveDate; dateReceiptSighting exists and returns the invoice_issue_date / invoice_issue_date_corrected bases; decideOwnPaperSighting writes dateBasis and effective_date: effectiveDate; the compare spreads observationDating(r.raw). Each of those 12 checks (11 required needles and the one that must be gone) was mutated singly and the verify failed every time; it fails against the 8c673db4b copies. Known limits, which it passes and the specs (own-paper-sighting.spec.ts, vendor-comparison.provenance.spec.ts, vp-register.test.ts) must catch: the noon placement, the one-day future tolerance, the content-hash day and the fallback sentences are behaviour, not text; a needle inside a string literal or a trailing comment still counts.
verify: python3 -c "import sys; code = lambda p: chr(10).join(l for l in open(p).read().splitlines() if not l.strip().startswith(('//', '/*', '*'))); P = 'apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/'; s = code(P + 'procurement.service.ts'); o = code(P + 'own-paper-sighting.ts'); v = code('apps/api-gateway/src/vendor-intel/vendor-comparison.service.ts'); need = [(s, 'observedAt: receiptDate.observedAt'), (s, 'dating: receiptDate'), (s, 'id, doc_type, doc_number, doc_date, status'), (s, 'args.sighting?.dating?.effectiveDate'), (s, '.eq(\"field_path\", \"issueDate\")'), (s, '.eq(\"kind\", \"correction\")'), (o, 'export function dateReceiptSighting('), (o, 'corrected ? \"invoice_issue_date_corrected\" : \"invoice_issue_date\"'), (o, 'dateBasis: input.dating.basis'), (o, 'effective_date: effectiveDate'), (v, '...observationDating(r.raw)')]; miss = [n for t, n in need if n not in t]; bad = 'observedAt: update.match_verified_at' in s; print('missing:', miss, '| old check-time dating present:', bad) if (miss or bad) else None; sys.exit(1 if (miss or bad) else 0)"
